onboarding.title: Set up Beresta
onboarding.mode_local_description: Your notes stay encrypted on this device. You can connect a sync server later without losing anything.
onboarding.mode_server_description: Your account is still created locally first. You can connect a sync server right after, or later from Settings.
onboarding.sync_prompt_description: You can connect this device to a self-hosted sync server now, or skip this and do it later from Settings — your local notes are unaffected either way.
onboarding.passphrase_hint: This passphrase protects your notes. Beresta cannot recover it if you forget it.
onboarding.switch_to_unlock: I already have an account at this location
unlock.title: Welcome back
unlock.description: Enter your passphrase to unlock your notes.
unlock.wipe_start_link: Can't unlock, or need to erase this device's copy?
unlock.wipe_warning: This permanently deletes every local file for this account on this device: notes, attachments, and revision history. It cannot be undone. Backups stored elsewhere are not affected.
shell.title: Your notes
shell.detail_placeholder: Select a note, or create one, to start editing.
attachments.dropzone_hint: Drag files here, or paste an image, to attach them.
revisions.restore_confirm: Restoring makes this the current version. The version it replaces stays in history.
settings.title: Settings
backups.title: Backups
backups.empty: No backups of this kind yet.
backups.restore_whole_confirm: This replaces your entire current notebook with this backup's content. A safety backup is taken first, but this cannot be undone from within the app.
export.title: Export
export.warning: Notes and attachments are exported as plain, unencrypted files. Anyone with access to the destination folder can read them.
import.title: Import
import.warnings_title: Some content could not be fully imported:
quicknote.title: Quick Note
shellintegration.title: Quick capture & startup
shellintegration.autostart_conflict: A different Beresta install is registered to launch at sign-in; enabling this will replace it.
sync.title: Synchronization
sync.status_offline_description: The configured server is unavailable. Local editing remains available.
sync.status_current_description: There are no known pending synchronization changes.
sync.server_unavailable: Server connection settings arrive in the synchronization phase. Your local collection will not need migration.
sync.connection_code_hint: Paste the connection code your server administrator shared (from a QR code or copied text). It already includes the server address, invite, and certificate verification.
sync.journal_empty: No synchronization conflicts or quarantined operations.
sync.quarantine_reason_unsupported_versi: This operation uses a protocol version this device does not support yet.
sync.quarantine_reason_verification_fail: This operation could not be verified and may be corrupted.
sync.quarantine_reason_empty_verified_op: This operation could not be processed.
sync.quarantine_reason_op_id_reuse: This operation reused an identifier with different content.
sync.quarantine_reason_apply_failed: This operation could not be applied to your local data.
sync.quarantine_reason_unknown: This operation could not be safely applied.
sync.revoke_confirm_description: This stops future synchronization for this device or person. It cannot erase notes or keys they already downloaded before now.
sync.devices_unavailable: Other devices and revocation controls appear after a server is connected.
sync.server_fingerprint_warning: Compare this fingerprint with the value shown by your server administrator before connecting.
sync.error_unauthorized: This device is not authorized. Request a new invite or verify that it has not been revoked.
sync.error_rate_limited: The server is receiving too many requests. Synchronization will retry automatically.
sync.error_quota_exceeded: The server storage quota is full. Remove unused attachments or ask the administrator to increase it.
sync.workspaces_description: A household member's device must already be connected to this same server (with its own invite code) before you can share a workspace with it.
sync.export_identity_description: Send this code to the owner of a workspace you want to join.
sync.qr_alt_grant: QR code for the workspace access you generated
sync.share_confirm_title: Give this device or person access?
sync.share_confirm_description: They will be able to read and change every note in this workspace. You can disconnect them later from the device list.
sync.share_success_description: Have them scan this code, or show the text version below.
sync.join_confirm_description: This becomes your active workspace. Your own notes stay on this device and are not deleted.
sync.join_success_description: This device now has access to the shared workspace.
errors.account_exists: An account already exists at this location. Try unlocking it instead.
errors.no_local_account: No local account exists at this location.
errors.not_found: This note is no longer available. It may have been deleted.
errors.wrong_workspace: That item does not belong to this workspace.
errors.unknown_workspace: This account has no known workspace.
errors.unlock_failed: The passphrase is incorrect, or this account's data is unreadable.
errors.notebook_cycle: A notebook can't be moved into one of its own sub-notebooks.
errors.keystore_unavailable: Windows key protection is unavailable on this device.
errors.key_invalidated: The platform key protecting this account was invalidated; the account must be re-created.
errors.already_exists: This device already holds a different key for this workspace.
errors.workspace_not_held: That workspace is not one this account holds.
errors.share_not_found: This workspace share was not found, or has already been revoked.
errors.backup_corrupt: This backup failed verification and cannot be restored.
errors.insufficient_space: Not enough free space at the backup destination.
errors.insufficient_attachment_space: Not enough free space to add this attachment.
errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
sync.status_local_only_description: This account is local-only. Changes stay safely on this computer.
sync.status_pending_description: Local changes are saved and queued to send to your configured server.
sync.status_retrying_description: A previous attempt failed. Beresta will try again automatically.
sync.status_action_required_description: Synchronization needs your attention. Local editing remains available.
about.privacy_defaults: Beresta enables no external product analytics, behavioral tracking, remote telemetry, or third-party crash upload by default.
emptystate.notes_description: Notes are stored immediately on this device.
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
data_check.issue_search_index_repaired: No problems found. A minor search index issue was automatically repaired.
data_check.issue_backup_needs_attention: Your backup needs attention. Create a new backup from Data settings.
data_check.issue_database_needs_restore: A local data problem was found. Restore from a backup in Data settings.
